note: CR-25.6: category composite scores that can be selected like any other score. A category is only offered when at least two benchmarks in it are on a 0-100-style, higher-is-better scale AND are measured for at least 60 % of the featured model families (measured with ops/ux-2026-09-12/bin/cr-25-6-coverage.mjs). The anchor set is fixed here, not derived per model: a model gets the category score only when it has a result on EVERY anchor, so two models' category scores are always an average over the same benchmarks. Where a benchmark exists in several versions, the build picks the one with the widest coverage (Terminal-Bench v4.0 over v2.1). Reasoning and Vision have only one qualifying benchmark each (Humanity's Last Exam, MMMU Pro) and therefore get no category score.
